assessments.reasoning: Section 3.2.1 constrains the minimum to the stated range and the optional maximum to that range and at least the minimum. Section 3.2.4 supplies 2^16 pages. Section 4.2.8 fixes each page size at 65,536 bytes.

challenge.method: Recompute the numerical bounds, exercise exactly 65,536, one greater, maximum below minimum and omitted maximum in a current validator, and compare later draft address types.
challenge.results: The inclusive limit is 65,536 and a missing maximum is allowed. A one-page sampled memory is exactly 65,536 bytes. These checks distinguish limits from achievable allocation and leave later address modes outside scope.

limitations: These are core type and page-size rules. They do not guarantee that an embedder can allocate or grow a memory to either limit.
Exact dated publications govern the scope. The independently constructed current-engine cases are a supplementary challenge.
